defaults.dtype: Omitted/None uses receiver scalar_type; no inference from data and no global default-dtype substitution. Explicit torch.dtype or Python float/int/bool/complex types accepted by parser; Python aliases map Double/Long/Bool/ComplexDouble.
defaults.device: Omitted/None resolves receiver legacy dispatch device type inside OptionalDeviceGuard(device_of(self)); guard preserves indexed receiver device. Explicit torch.device/string or nonnegative integer accelerator index overrides; symbolic integer device forms guard/specialize. Backend admission/device initialization remains separate.
defaults.requires_grad: DefaultFalse; parser bool parameter, then result.detach_() and set_requires_grad. True requires isDifferentiableType(dtype). Tensor data emits UserWarning before construction; warning-as-error can abort.
defaults.layout_and_pinning: No built-in keyword parameters. Tensor route preserves input layout through .to; sequence/storage/array routes have their own layout/storage behavior. No API control of pinned allocation is forwarded.
